description: This is a Java test class for the RatingStatistics component in a book tracking application. It contains unit tests for methods that find the lowest and highest rated books, calculate the average rating, and handle cases with no ratings.

classes.name: RatingStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for the RatingStatistics component, verifying functionality related to book ratings.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, resetting the book service and populating test books.

methods.name: findLowestRatedBookExists
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the lowest rated book.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentLowestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests behavior when no books are rated, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: findHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the highest rated book.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests behavior when no books are rated, expecting an empty result.

methods.name: findAverageRating
methods.description: Verifies the calculation of the average rating across books.

methods.name: notDivideAverageRatingByZero
methods.description: Ensures that the average rating calculation handles division by zero gracefully.

methods.name: resetRatingStatistics
methods.description: Resets the test state by deleting all books and reinitializing the RatingStatistics object.
